d: Samajvadi parti ke sansthapak sadasyon men shamil aur uttar pradesh ki siyasat ka ek aisa chehra, jise aap pasand karen ya napsand, lekin nazraandaz nahin kar sakte. satta ke shikhar se lekar panch sal ke lanbe jel pravas aur saikron muqadmon tak, aazam khan ka safar kaee ansuljhe saval khare karta hai. samarthakon ke lie bebak aavaz aur aalochkon ke lie ek sanpradayik chehra mane jane vale aazam khan ki asli shakhsiyat kya hai?
